description:
Rocket.Chat is open at the login screen in the browser. Log in with:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Navigate to the public channel #release-updates (preloaded with real release announcements from the official Rocket.Chat GitHub releases feed). Find the message announcing release 8.0.0 (published 2026-01-12) and pin it to the channel. The pinned message should contain the text about the 8.0.0 release.
